inputs.query: SELECT TOP 14 g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.parallax,g.parallax_error,g.ruwe,g.astrometric_params_solved,d.r_med_geo,d.r_lo_geo,d.r_hi_geo,d.r_med_photogeo,d.r_lo_photogeo,d.r_hi_photogeo FROM gaia.dr3lite AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gedr3dist.main AS d ON g.source_id=d.source_id WHERE g.source_id IN (5853498713190525696,4472832130942575872,4295806720,34361129088,38655544960,2067082282304626432,762815470562110464) OR g.source_id BETWEEN 1 AND 90000000000 ORDER BY g.source_id

SELECT TOP 4 g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.parallax,g.parallax_error,g.ruwe,g.astrometric_params_solved,d.r_med_geo,d.r_lo_geo,d.r_hi_geo,d.r_med_photogeo,d.r_lo_photogeo,d.r_hi_photogeo FROM gaia.dr3lite AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gedr3dist.main AS d ON g.source_id=d.source_id WHERE g.source_id BETWEEN 1 AND 3000000000000 AND (g.parallax < 0 OR g.parallax IS NULL) ORDER BY g.source_id

SELECT TOP 3 g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.parallax,g.parallax_error,g.ruwe,g.astrometric_params_solved,d.r_med_geo,d.r_lo_geo,d.r_hi_geo,d.r_med_photogeo,d.r_lo_photogeo,d.r_hi_photogeo FROM gaia.dr3lite AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gedr3dist.main AS d ON g.source_id=d.source_id WHERE g.source_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6000000000000 AND g.parallax IS NULL ORDER BY g.source_id

SELECT targetid,desiname,mean_fiber_ra,mean_fiber_dec,mean_mjd,z,zerr,zwarn,deltachi2,healpix,survey,program,spectype,zcat_primary FROM desi_dr1.zpix WHERE targetid BETWEEN 39628379988689570 AND 39628379988689900 AND survey='main' AND program='bright' AND spectype='GALAXY' AND zcat_primary=true AND zwarn=0 ORDER BY targetid LIMIT 12
Project the first confirmed planet from each pinned systems/51 Peg.xml, systems/HR 8799.xml and systems/TRAPPIST-1.xml into numeric orbit elements, source paths and aliases; omit prose and images.
